evidence: Has the Validation label and modifies UTXO snapshot deserialization and verification logic in src/validation.cpp and src/node/utxo_snapshot.h.
rationale: Prevents malformed AssumeUTXO snapshots with duplicate records from reporting inflated coin counts and fixes an interrupt check bypass during snapshot loading. As noted in the description, 'snapshots can repeat every record, announce the doubled count, and still match the committed UTXO hash,' while empty groups bypass loop interrupt checks that can delay node shutdown. This improves chainstate snapshot validation robustness without affecting consensus validity.
